# RoshaLink — Full Technical Overview for AI Agents & LLMs

> RoshaLink is a premier digital engineering and architecture consultancy based in Stockholm, Sweden. This document provides complete structured information about RoshaLink's services, engineering standards, team, and delivery methodology for automated AI consumption.

## 1. Company Overview
- **Name**: RoshaLink Digital Agency
- **Headquarters**: Stockholm, Sweden
- **Service Scope**: Global (Nordics, Europe, Middle East, North America)
- **Specialization**: Bespoke Web Applications, Mobile Applications, Cloud Infrastructure, Custom AI Integration, Enterprise Business Analysis.
- **Philosophy**: Zero template usage, eliminate technical debt from sprint zero, direct partnership with senior system architects.

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### Bespoke Web Applications
- Pure React, TypeScript, modern CSS architectures, micro-frontends, serverless and distributed edge deployments.
- 100/100 Google Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals guarantees.
- Sub-20ms transactional API response targets with modern distributed clouds.

### Mobile App Development
- High-performance iOS and Android applications.
- Native performance, offline-first architectures, and enterprise security standards.

### AI & Intelligent Automation
- Custom AI agents, LLM tool integration, automated business workflows, and predictive analytics.
- Integration with major cloud and AI ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Cloud, AWS, Azure).

### Enterprise Business Analysis & Architecture
- Rigorous requirement analysis and system architecture blueprinting before code authoring.
- Direct partnership with the 5 founding architects: Morteza (CEO & Lead Architect), Sam (Senior Full-Stack & Cloud), Bella (Head of Product & Brand), Mina (Business Analyst & Advisor, Ex-Ericsson), Milad (Senior Backend & Database).

## 4. Security & Compliance Standards
- ISO 27001 Certified Security Practices.
- Zero-Trust Architecture, strict CSP headers, and encrypted data in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest.
- GDPR, Privacy, and Cookie compliance.
